title: Explainable deep learning classifies and localizes findings on chest radiographs
summary: VinDr-CXR was trained on 51,485 chest radiographs with radiologist bounding boxes. On a retrospective validation set of 3,000 scans it reached a mean AUROC of 0.967 (95% CI 0.958-0.975) for six common thoracic diseases, comparable to experienced radiologists, with sensitivity 0.933 and specificity 0.900. The abstract also reports improved interobserver agreement when radiologists used the system. Retrospective data; preprint of 2021-09-30.
ai_technology: Explainable deep learning system (VinDr-CXR) that classifies thoracic diseases and localizes findings on chest radiographs

evidence.tested: Retrospective validation on 3,000 scans (mean AUROC 0.967) and a reader assessment of interobserver agreement.
evidence.unknown: Performance in other populations, prospective clinical benefit and peer-reviewed status are not established from the abstract; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A deep learning system classified and localized thoracic findings on chest radiographs and assisted readers.
